reason: A Playwright-based DeepSeek Harness plugin that enables agents to navigate and interact with real browsers through accessibility snapshots, stable references, screenshots, tab management, structured extraction, and optionally gated JavaScript evaluation.

summaries.zh: 通过 Playwright 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于无障碍快照的浏览器导航、交互、截图、标签页管理和结构化提取工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with Playwright-based browser navigation, accessibility-tree interaction, screenshots, tab management, and structured page extraction.

capabilities: click, fill, press keys, scroll, and manage browser tabs
capture screenshots and return accessibility-tree snapshots
extract structured data from pages using an auxiliary model route
execute arbitrary page JavaScript when explicitly enabled
persist cookies, storage, and login state within a harness session
